lines: Battle on the border between Greenglade and Rivermarch. Thornmane Clans (arrived) with the Thornmane Clans army at Greenglade (3 units, no commander); Aurel Crown (arrived) with the Aurel Crown army at Rivermarch (3 units, no commander).
Round 1: Thornmane Clans dealt 8 damage (2 of 3 hits), Aurel Crown dealt 9 damage (2 of 3 hits). Thornmane Clans' Fangthrowers fell.

Round 2: Thornmane Clans dealt 8 damage (2 of 2 hits), Aurel Crown dealt 13 damage (3 of 3 hits). Aurel Crown's Spearmen fell. Thornmane Clans broke and fled after losing 70% of its strength (morale 7 holds only to 55%). Aurel Crown broke and fled after losing 50% of its strength (morale 6 holds only to 50%).
Casualties: Thornmane Clans lost 1 of 3 fighters, and the other 2 fled; Aurel Crown lost 1 of 3 fighters.
Hits: Thornmane Clans hit 80% of the time (4 of 5; each attack had a 68% chance); Aurel Crown hit 83% of the time (5 of 6; each attack had a 76-84% chance, about 81% on average).
Result: Aurel Crown won after 2 rounds: both sides broke in the same round, and Aurel Crown had more of its strength left.

Why: Aurel Crown's Spearmen held their shield wall (+2 defense), turning aside about 5 damage; Thornmane Clans broke after losing 70% of its strength (morale 7 holds only to 55%) and fled with 9 hp unspent; Aurel Crown's Crossbowmen shot over their own front rank, out of reach, for about 8 damage.
Aftermath: Thornmane Clans routed, and its army was destroyed as it fled (3 fighters lost; there are no retreats yet).
